div.div: بَذَّالٌ A man wont to give property liberally, freely, or willingly; or who so gives it much, or frequently; as also ↓ بَذُولٌ (T, TA) [and app. ↓ مِبْذَالٌ , (like مِسْمَاحٌ &c.,) of which the pl. occurs in the following saying]. ↓ هُمْ مَبَاذِيلُ لِلْمَعْرُوفِ [They are very liberally disposed to the exercise of beneficence, or bounty]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
